idea.oneLine: A lead and follow-up tracker for small sales teams
idea.outcome: Sales reps never miss a follow-up and managers see the pipeline without asking

facts.text: The team of 8 reps currently tracks leads in spreadsheets

assumptions.text: Fewer than 10,000 leads per team in year one
Reps use Microsoft 365 mail, so Graph API sync is acceptable

recommendations.rationale: A small team and modest scale do not justify service boundaries yet

research.claim: PostgreSQL supports row-level security for tenant isolation

personas.name: Sales rep
goals: Log a lead in under 30 seconds

personas.name: Sales manager
painPoints: Status meetings to learn what is stuck

requirements.text: Reps can create and edit leads
Reps get reminders for due follow-ups
Managers see leads grouped by pipeline stage

requirements.measurable: p95 under 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users on staging hardware

requirements.text: Mail sync attaches emails to leads
Teams can only access their own data
Supports the expected year-one data volume
requirements.measurable: 10,000 leads and 200 concurrent users per team

features.name: Follow-up reminders
features.description: Schedule follow-ups and notify reps when due

successMetrics.metric: Overdue follow-ups per rep per week
successMetrics.measurement: query on follow-up due vs completed timestamps

stack.tradeoffs: Fast to build and self-documenting; async ecosystem is smaller than Node

alternatives.name: MongoDB
alternatives.tradeoff: weaker relational reporting for pipeline totals

stack.tradeoffs: Strong consistency and RLS for tenant isolation; needs migrations discipline

stack.choice: Microsoft Graph mail adapter behind a port

alternatives.name: IMAP polling
alternatives.tradeoff: works with any provider but is slower and harder to secure

stack.tradeoffs: Adapter keeps the provider replaceable; requires tenant admin consent

architecture.securityModel: RBAC with tenant isolation enforced at API, service, repository and database layers
architecture.operational: Single region managed hosting, daily backups, structured logs with PII masked

targets.target: under 2 seconds at the stated load

risks.text: Graph API consent blocks mail sync
risks.mitigation: Ship the MVP without mail sync; make it milestone 4

milestones.title: Foundation and lead capture
milestones.goal: Auth, tenant isolation and lead CRUD
acceptanceCriteria: A rep can create and find a lead
milestones.verification: API tests plus a Playwright journey for lead creation

milestones.title: Pipeline board
acceptanceCriteria: p95 under 2 seconds on the seeded dataset
milestones.verification: Load test with recorded baseline and result

milestones.title: Follow-up reminders
acceptanceCriteria: A due follow-up produces exactly one reminder
milestones.verification: Integration test with a fake clock

milestones.title: Mail sync
acceptanceCriteria: Sent mail appears on the lead
milestones.verification: Contract tests against the adapter port

openDecisions.question: Is Microsoft 365 the mail provider for every team?
openDecisions.defaultChoice: Assume yes and confirm before milestone 4
